name: doc_forensics
description: Reads what a published file leaks about itself: PDF Info dictionaries, OOXML docProps, ZIP entry listings, and image EXIF (camera, software, GPS). Also scans text and code for credential-shaped strings and extracts URLs, and reports both in a form that distinguishes what the file says from what it proves. Everything is read from a local file; nothing is uploaded, and nothing outside the file is touched.

operation.description: One of: metadata | secrets_scan | links | compare | sources. Defaults to metadata.

path.description: Path to the file to inspect. Required by every operation.

patterns.description: Comma-separated extra secret patterns to scan for (name=regex pairs are not supported here; use a pattern name like 'slack', 'aws', 'jwt' or a raw regex).

max_matches.description: Maximum secret matches to report. Defaults to 20.

limit.description: Maximum links to return. Defaults to 40.

author: Stella
notes: Readers are pure-Python (core/docs/metadata.py): PDF Info, OOXML docProps, ZIP entries, JPEG EXIF, PNG chunks. Matches are reported with their location, never the value in full.
